name: Difix3D Pipeline
definition: A training pipeline that periodically generates novel camera poses, renders them via a 3D model, and uses a pretrained diffusion model to remove degradation from the rendered images, then retrains on the fixed images.
summary: Difix3D Pipeline periodically synthesizes novel views and uses a 1-step diffusion model to remove degradation, distinguishing itself by enhancing HDR deblurring and novel view synthesis quality.
